Message from you:
Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
A
Message from Alen Customer Experience Team:
Yes—here are the main beginner “get started” items: 
Unbox + prep: Take your Alen out of the box and remove all protective films. Your filter is already inside the unit, so you’ll need to open the front panel to unwrap your filter.
Placement: Place your Alen along your room’s longest wall, at least 18 inches away from furniture.
Run it: Plug it in and press the power button to turn it on. Leave your Alen running 24/7 for best results.
Register your purifier (Forever Guarantee): Register your Alen using the serial number (found on the back of your unit). If you don’t register your new purifier, you won’t be able to activate your Forever Guarantee.
Filter subscription (optional, but easiest): You can set up a filter subscription to get 10% off every filter, free shipping, and reward points for every filter. You can choose a delivery frequency that works for you, and you won’t be charged until your next filter ships. You can easily modify the ship date as needed. Cancel subscription anytime.
App (optional): Connect your Alen to Wifi using the Alen Air app so you can control your unit remotely, monitor your air quality, and keep track of the types of particulate matter in your air.
